params.name: query
params.description: Search query to filter alerts. Uses OpsGenie query language syntax.

params.name: searchIdentifier
params.description: Identifier of a saved search to use for filtering alerts.

params.name: searchIdentifierType
params.description: Type of the saved search identifier. Possible values are id or name.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting index for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort results by. Possible values include createdAt, updatedAt, tinyId, alias, message, status, acknowledged, isSeen, snoozed, count, lastOccurredAt, and owner.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for the results. Possible values are desc and asc.
